content:
mike: Heads-up — CI just flagged the audit event validator on main. failed tests in `audit-fixtures-check` after the RBAC patch.
elaine: :eyes: which test exactly? stack or golden mismatch?
jordan: Got the failure too. Looks like golden fixtures in `tests/golden/events` differ — schema validator says unexpected field `actor_role` on some events.
val: We added `actor_role` as part of RBAC telemetry last week. It should be optional though.
mike: The surprising part is the validator rejecting optional field. error snippet from CI log:

```
ValidationError: Additional properties not allowed ('actor_role' was unexpected)
  at validateEvent (/repo/eng/security/audit-validator/index.js:142:15)
  at Object.compareGolden (/repo/tests/golden/checker.py:78:12)
```

audit-bot: CI: audit-fixtures-check failed on commit d4f9a2c — see https://ci.internal/redwood/12345 :x:
elaine: Hmm could be schema version mismatch. Did the validator load the old schema file in the docker image?
jordan: Reproducer locally: run `make test-audit-fixtures` -> fails. The golden JSONs already contain `actor_role` in ~12 fixtures.
val: When we added actor_role it was behind a feature flag for dedicated customers; the field should be present for some events but schema must allow it. I probably forgot to bump schema version.
mike: Two immediate causes: schema file not updated in validator image OR the normalize step strips feature-flag fields and then golden vs generated ordering mismatches. Also we had CI caching of built artifacts last week.
elaine: Also seeing flaky timestamps in golden fixtures — some fixtures got `created_at` with ms precision vs trimmed seconds. That makes the comparator noisy.
sre-oncall: For flakiness we should normalize time/uuid before compare. We already have `normalizers.py` but looks like it doesn't run in the golden-check job.

jordan: Proposal:
- patch validator to accept actor_role as optional (update JSON Schema with `actor_role?: string`)
- add pre-compare normalizer step in CI to canonicalize `created_at`, `id` and `request_id`
- update Dockerfile to copy new schema and bump validator image tag in CI

val: Agree. Also we need to communicate to Dedicated teams that `actor_role` will appear in audit events. Add to changelog.
mike: Can we make validator stricter for production but permissive in test harness? i.e., validator config `strict: true|false` depending on env.
elaine: I like strict in prod, permissive in test but have a test that asserts schema-incompatibility is detected. We should also add a regression test that intentionally adds a new optional field and verifies the golden-check tolerates it.

audit-bot: Note: deploy-blocker flag not set for this CI job. Current failure is non-blocking but flaky tests may raise it if we see >5 failures in 24h.
jordan: Quick fix PR incoming: small schema bump + normalizer hook in `ci/audit-check.sh`. I'll also pin the validator image to `audit-validator:2026-03-18-rc1`.
val: After PR we should run `./scripts/generate-golden --regenerate --normalize` and check diffs.
mike: Long-term: add schema versioning field to audit events like `audit_schema:v2` so consumers can gate. Also introduce a linter pre-commit that prevents accidental addition of non-declared fields in `tests/golden/*`.
elaine: One more caveat — there was a KMS-related change that adds `kms_key_id` to encryption events. That one is customer-facing and must be allowed. We need an allowlist of fields that are permitted even if not in older schema.

sre-oncall: I've scheduled a short on-call rota to watch CI for next 6 hours. Will poke if the flake reappears.
mike: Thanks. Jordan, can you drop the PR link here when ready and include a test that demonstrates normalize step passing?
jordan: Will do — sending PR in ~20m. Title: "audit: schema optional actor_role + ci normalization". I'll include the debug script and CI logs.
val: I'll draft the changelog blurb and ping PG for Dedicated customers.
elaine: Good plan. After this we should run a smoke e2e harness to ensure no downstream services break.
mike: Cool. If anyone hits more weirdness, @mike please DM the logs. :thumbsup:"
